entries.content: Oblivion.exe (Ghidra decompiled) - Gamebryo engine, compiled with VS2005/VS2008, Direct3D9. Init order: Renderer -> Shader System -> Sky -> TES -> TreeManager -> Menus -> Player -> Scripts -> Sound System -> Actor Locations -> LOD Land

Gamebryo scene graph: 'Oblivion World Scene Graph' and 'Oblivion Interface 3D Object Scene Graph' two-layer structure. NiNode Pool. BSFaceGenNiNodeBiped, BSFaceGenNiNodeSkinned for face gen. NiCollisionSwitch, NiCollisionData for collision.

Render: D3D9.DLL -> Direct3DCreate9. Hardware T&L required (not supported fallback). Pixel/Vertex Shader 3.0 required (GeForce4 4400 or Radeon 8500+). Windowed mode check. BackBuffer multisampling handling. D3DXCreateTextureFromFileA, D3DXCreateTexture (256x256), D3DXCreateTextureFromFileInMemory, D3DXSaveTextureToFileA for screenshot.
BSA archives: 'Oblivion - Meshes.bsa' confirmed. Loading: .esp -> replace extension to *.bsa -> open. ESM/ESP load order: Oblivion.esm, OblivionSE.esm.

TES file system: TESFile class with ZLib inflate/deflate for compressed forms. Save header: 'TES4SAVEGAME' (12 bytes). TESSaveLoadGame::LoadForm, TESSaveLoadGame::UnloadForm, TESSaveLoadGame::SaveQueuedHavokData. Save version tracking, buffer overrun/underrun checks.

Script system: BSScript compiler, ScriptCompiler::StandardCompile with param validation. Compiles scripts from ESM/ESP with line-level error reporting. Variable ID lookup, references to actors/containers/spells/items/sounds.

UI menu system (Scaleform GFx/Flash): 48 XML menu files confirmed. Categories: Main HUD (hud_main_menu, hud_reticle, hud_info, safe_zone, inventory, magic, map, stats, quickkeys, subtitle), Options (main, pause, save, load, options, video, audio, controls, gameplay, credits), Chargen (race_sex, class, skills), Dialog (dialog, persuasion, spell_purchase, spellmaking, enchantment, alchemy), Others (book, container, lockpick, levelup, loading, message, quantity, recharge, repair, sleep_wait, training, negotiate, breath_meter).

Havok physics engine integrated: LoadHavokData, SaveQueuedHavokData, collision object management. bhkFixedConstraint. Bone count validation on load. Arrow collision detection with actors/references. NiCollisionSwitch for enabling/disabling collision.

Asset file types: NIF (meshes - Clothes/Armor/Weapons/Clutter/Sky/Markers), DDS (textures - sky/sun/water/effects/menus/icons/shadows), KF (animations - Idle, Death), WAV/MP3 (audio - TES4Title.mp3), BIK (video - OblivionIntro.bik). Shader path: 'data\shaders\'. Texture paths: 'Textures\Menus', 'Textures\Sky'. Water textures: 'Water\water00.dds'.

Water system: Water Node, LODWaterRoot, Interior Water Node. Parameters configurable: fAlpha, uSurfaceTextureSize (128), water velocity, direction, amplitude, frequency, reflectivity, opacity. Multiple water types tied to worldspace. Water art asset validation against .ini.

HDR/Bloom lighting: Current HDR Params with fEyeAdaptSpeed, fEmissiveHDRMult. SunGlareNonHDR.dds for non-HDR fallback. Multiple render paths available (shader-based). RendererInfo.txt output: RenderPath, Shaders 3.0, Water shader, Water reflections, Water displacement, Water high res, Bloom, Shader Package.

Audio: DirectSound8 (DirectSoundCreate8). Bink video sound system (_BinkOpenDirectSound). PlaySoundA for launcher (LauncherMusic.wav). Threading: CreateThread for worker thread, SetThreadPriority (range -2 to 15), WaitForSingleObject, CriticalSection (8+ sections), Sleep(50ms) for main loop. TLS (TlsFree) for thread-local interfaces.

INI settings: Oblivion.ini, Oblivion_default.ini. Read via GetPrivateProfileIntA/GetPrivateProfileStringA. bUseMyGamesDirectory (General section). bAllowScreenShot (Display section). fQuestDelayTime gameplay setting. BlendSettings.ini also referenced. Launcher writes Plugins.txt and DLCList.txt.

World/Cell system: Exterior Cell Buffer and Interior Cell Buffer. Default worldspace 'Tamriel'. Starting cell lookup (Could not find starting cell). Cell water type lookup per worldspace. LOD land initialization per worldspace. Block/SubBlock structure for exterior cells.

Magic effects use 4-char codes: WBAR (Water Breathing), WAWA (Water Walking), DWSR (Resist Water Damage). FPS display: 'FPS %d (%d)' and 'FPS %d (Type %d)'. Memory debug: 'Game not compiled with MEM_DEBUG.' Memory stats: block/free/used/heap tracking.

OblivionLauncher.exe: Windowed launcher with 'Oblivion Launcher' title, 'The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion' window text. Reads registry 'Software\Bethesda Softworks\Oblivion' for install path. Manages Oblivion.ini, Oblivion_default.ini, Plugins.txt, DLCList.txt. Creates Plugins.txt with header comment. Plays LauncherMusic.wav. Launches setup.exe for installer.

Sharp.BSA.BA2 (SharpBSABA2) - Actual BSA parsing library source code, GPLv3, from AlexxEG/BSA_Browser on GitHub. Solution structure: Sharp.BSA.BA2.csproj (.NET 4.0, AllowUnsafeBlocks). Namespace: SharpBSABA2. Dependencies: ICSharpCode.SharpZipLib (ZLib), K4os.Compression.LZ4 (LZ4), lz4.AnyCPU.loader. Enums: ArchiveTypes { BA2_DX10, BA2_GNRL, BA2_GNMF, BSA, BSA_XN, BSA_MW, BSA_SE, DAT_F2 }.

Oblivion BSA binary format (from SharpBSABA2 source):
HEADER (36 bytes): Magic=0x00415342 ('BSA\0'), Version=0x67 (OB), FolderRecordOffset (uint32), ArchiveFlags (uint32), FolderCount (uint32), FileCount (uint32), FolderNameLength (uint32), FileNameLength (uint32), FileFlags (uint32).
FOLDER RECORDS (per folder): Hash (uint64), FileCount (uint32), _pad/unk (4 bytes), Offset (uint32) -- Offset points to folder name in string table.
FOLDER NAME STRING TABLE: each name is length-prefixed (byte length - 1), null-terminated. Length byte is offset 0x10000 into string pool.
FILE RECORDS (per file in folder): Hash (uint64), Size (uint32), Offset (uint32).
NAME TABLE (at end): null-terminated strings in format 'folder\filename' for each file (in order).
COMPRESSION: ZLib (deflate) via ICSharpCode.SharpZipLib.Inflater. Bit 30 (0x40000000) of Size field toggles compression per-entry relative to ArchiveFlags.Compressed flag.
RetrieveRealSize option: reads 4-byte uncompressed size before each compressed data block.
Supported versions: 0x67 (Oblivion), 0x68 (Fallout 3), 0x69 (Skyrim SE).

Oblivion BSA ArchiveFlags field: bit 0 (0x1) = HasNameTable (folder+file name strings present), bit 1 (0x2) = HasFolderNames, bit 2 (0x4) = Compressed (OB_BSAARCHIVE_COMPRESSFILES). Fallout 3 adds bit 8 (0x100 = F3_BSAARCHIVE_PREFIXFULLFILENAMES) for full path name blobs per-file. SSE adds bit 12 (0x1000) and bit 13 (0x2000). HasNameTable is TRUE when both bit 0 AND bit 1 are set.

BSA compression toggle logic (from SharpBSABA2): ArchiveFlags.Compressed flag indicates whether files are compressed by default. Per-entry Size field bit 30 (0x40000000) acts as a per-file toggle: if set, the entry's compression state is INVERTED relative to the archive flag. XOR logic: isCompressed = ArchiveFlags.Compressed ^ ((size & 0x40000000) != 0). Size with bit 30 masked out: size ^= 0x40000000.

BSA per-file extraction algorithm (from SharpBSABA2 BSAFileEntry.WriteDataToStream):
1. Seek to Offset in archive
2. If ContainsFileNameBlobs (FO3/SSE): read 1 byte (name length), skip that many bytes + 1
3. If decompress=true AND compressed:
   a. Read uint32 (4 bytes) -- this is a pre-decompression size marker specific to OB format
   b. Decompress 'Size - 4' bytes using ZLib Inflater (ICSharpCode.SharpZipLib)
4. If decompress=false: directly copy 'Size' bytes (or 'Size - nameBlobOverhead' for SSE)
For SSE: LZ4 decompression (K4os.Compression.LZ4) instead of ZLib.

SharpBSABA2 namespace full API:
- Archive (abstract): FullPath, FileName, FileSize, LastWriteTime, FileCount, HasNameTable, VersionString, Type (ArchiveTypes), Chunks, Encoding, Inflater (SharpZipLib), Files (List<ArchiveEntry>), BinaryReader. Constructors: Archive(filePath), Archive(filePath, encoding), Archive(filePath, encoding, retrieveRealSize). Methods: Close(), CreateSharedParams(bool reader, bool inflater).
- ArchiveEntry (abstract): FullPath, FileName, Folder, LowerPath, FullPathOriginal, Extension, Index, Offset, Size, RealSize, DisplaySize, Compressed, HadHashTranslated, nameHash, dirHash, BytesWritten, Archive. Methods: Extract(dest, preserveFolder, newName, extractParams), GetDataStream(extractParams), GetRawDataStream(extractParams), GetSizeInArchive(extractParams).
- SharedExtractParams: Reader (BinaryReader), Inflater (SharpZipLib). Used for multi-threaded extraction.
- BSA (BSAUtil): IsSupportedVersion(filePath, encoding) static method. Magic, Header (BSAHeader|BSAHeaderMW), Compressed, ContainsFileNameBlobs, Type (override: BSA, BSA_SE, BSA_MW, BSA_XN, DAT_F2).
- BSAHeader (struct): Version (uint32), FolderRecordOffset (uint32), ArchiveFlags (uint32), FolderCount, FileCount, FolderNameLength, FileNameLength, FileFlags.
- BSAHeaderMW (struct): Version, HashOffset, FileCount. Size=12 bytes.
- BSAFileEntry: Version (BSAFileVersion enum: BSA/Morrowind/Fallout2), mwNameHash (Morrowind 64-bit hash).
- BSAFolderInfo: Hash (uint64), FileCount, Unk1 (SSE only), Offset (pointer to folder name).
- BSAFileInfo (struct): Hash (uint64), SizeFlags (uint32), Offset (uint32).
- DAT2FileEntry (struct): FilenameSize, Filename, Compressed, RealSize, PackedSize, Offset.
- XNGBSAFileEntry: RecordId, supports LZSS decompression.

ESM world generation: Added WorldManager::addCellFromESM() and Cell::editorID field. createTestScenario() now builds world from ESM CELL/NPC_/WEAP records instead of hardcoded data. NDK build passes with zero errors.

SPEL record parsing implemented: SpellData struct with formID, editorID, fullName, spellType, cost, level, flags, effectFormIDs, effectMagnitudes, effectAreas, effectDurations. decodeSpell() reads SPIT (magic data) and iterates EFID+EFIT pairs for effect list. Build: SUCCESS

NAVM record parsing implemented: NavMeshData struct with vertices (glm::vec3), triangles (vertex indices + adjacency), cellFormID. decodeNavMesh() reads NNAM (location), NVNM (version header + vertices + triangles). Build: SUCCESS

ARMO record parsing implemented: ArmorData struct with armorRating, value, weight, enchantmentID, armorType (light/heavy/cloth), modelPath. decodeArmor() reads BMDT (body data/type), DATA (rating+value+weight), ENAM (enchantment). Build: SUCCESS

BOOK/FACT/RACE/CLAS record parsing implemented: BookData (teachesSkillID), FactionData (ranks, relations), RaceData (model paths, spells), ClassData (specialization, attributes, skills). All 4 records parse their core DATA subrecords. Build: SUCCESS

CLOT/INGR/ALCH/MISC/ROAD record parsing implemented: ClothingData (value, weight, enchant), IngredientData (4 alchemy effects via IRQD/IRQF), AlchemyData (EFID+EFIT effects), MiscItemData (value, weight), RoadData (PGRP nodes, PGRR edges). Build: SUCCESS

NAVM A* pathfinding implemented: NavMeshManager with findPath(start, end) returning vector<glm::vec3>. Uses triangle centroids as nodes, adjacent edges as connections. findTriangle() for point containment. getTriangleCentroid() uses component-wise division (glm compatibility). Integrated in renderer.cpp. Files: navmesh_manager.h, navmesh_manager.cpp

ESM integration fully complete: 4 spell effects (PARALYZE, INVISIBILITY, FORTIFY_ATTR, SUMMON), DIAL/INFO dialogue with faction branching, REFR-based world object placement (8 types), NavMesh combat integration. All esm_integration_tasks marked done.
Build environment: JAVA_HOME must be set to JDK 17 (C:\Program Files\Eclipse Adoptium\jdk-17.0.20.101-hotspot) before running gradlew. Gradle 9.4.1 requires JVM 17+. NDK 30.0.14904198.
Commit messages must be bilingual: English on top, Japanese below, separated by --- line. Example: feat: title (EN) then --- then feat: title (JA).
New game systems added in this session: alchemy_system, book_reader, clothing_converter, faction_manager, loot_generator, misc_item_converter, navmesh_manager. All in app/src/main/cpp/game/.

Next phase tasks (Phase 1 remaining): NIF collision (bhkCollisionObject) priority 5, NIF skeleton/skinning priority 4, NIF animation complete priority 3. Phase 2-3: SpeedTree, FaceGen, Recast/Detour, Ozz-animation, Script VM, Jolt physics, Radiant AI.
dialogue.cpp needs LOGI macro defined (not just LOGD/LOGE). Added #define LOGI(...) __android_log_print(ANDROID_LOG_INFO, LOG_TAG, __VA_ARGS__) to fix build error.

Phase 30 Steps 7-12 completed: NiControllerManager/Sequence parsing, AnimationPlayer (slerp/lerp/text keys), bhkCollisionObject + bhkRigidBody parsing (9 shape types), Dynamic AABB Tree (broad-phase), CollisionWorld (table-driven narrow phase 5x5, ContactBuffer), CharacterController (substep movement, multi-ray ground detection). Custom GLM extended with quat struct and vec3 operators. All 4 architectures build successful.

README structure preference: English section on top, Japanese section below. No inline bilingual format ('English / 日本語'). Each section is self-contained and independently readable. This applies to all future README updates.

Imperial Weave v3 実装完了。EventBus(type_index + shared_ptr) + ServiceLocator + 8フェーズ更新パイプライン。Rendererから重複Manager呼び出しを段階的に削除中（world, quest, combat完了）。残り: playerController, inventoryManager, spellManager, audioManager
戦闘システム強化完了。9武器タイプ(短剣/長剣/大剣/斧/メイス/大槌/弓/杖/徒手)、ヒットボックス(AABB)、クリティカル/ブロック/パリィ/ドッジ、出血DoT(斧)、戦闘イベントキュー(ImperialWeave連携)、NPC AI戦闘ロジック(攻撃/防御/魔法選択)
CombatEvent構造体を拡張。timestamp, targetId, weaponName, isCritical, isBlocked フィールドを追加。createCombatEvent()ヘルパー関数で統一的なイベント作成。CombatManagerからImperial Weave EventBusへのイベント送信を実装。renderer.cppでEventBus接続を確立。

Imperial Weave 12-phase update pipeline: PreUpdate → EventProcess → WorldUpdate → AiUpdate → PlayerUpdate → InventoryUpdate → SpellUpdate → AnimationUpdate → PhysicsSync → CombatUpdate → QuestUpdate → AudioUpdate → RenderSubmit. All major managers migrated.
Joystick input and audio listener position must be set BEFORE ImperialWeave::update() is called, because playerController->update() and audioManager->update() now run inside the Weave pipeline.
titleScreen and uiSystem remain directly called from Renderer (not migrated to Imperial Weave) because they are UI/rendering overlay systems, not game logic managers.

Player combat UI buttons implemented: Attack (ATK, red), Block (BLK, blue), Cast Spell (MAG, purple). Positioned on right side of screen. Attack triggers playerController->attack(), Block toggles combat stance. Buttons hidden on title screen, shown on game start.

PlayerController connected to Imperial Weave EventBus for animation events. subscribeToCombatEvents() registers handlers for COMBAT_ATTACK_HIT, COMBAT_CRITICAL_HIT, COMBAT_BLOCK, COMBAT_PARRY, COMBAT_DODGE, COMBAT_DEATH. Currently logs events; actual animation triggers are TODO.

NPC animation state machine implemented: AnimState enum (IDLE, WALK, RUN, ATTACK, HIT_REACTION, BLOCK, DEATH). Timing constants: HIT_REACTION_DURATION=0.5s, ATTACK_DURATION=0.8s. Auto-returns to IDLE after animation completes. CombatManager::applyDamage() now triggers target->triggerHitReaction() and target->triggerDeath().

AnimationSubscriber system implemented. Bridges NPC animation states to WorldEntity animation playback via Imperial Weave EventBus. Subscribes to COMBAT_ATTACK_HIT, COMBAT_CRITICAL_HIT, COMBAT_DEATH events. Maps NPC AnimState to animation names (idle, walk, run, attack, hit_reaction, block, death). WorldEntity storage added to WorldLoader with npcToEntityMap for NPC ID → Entity ID lookup. loadActorForNpc() method loads actors with NPC ID association. AnimationPlayer enhanced with findSequenceByName() for semantic animation lookup.

AudioSubscriber system implemented. Bridges combat and animation events to AudioManager sound playback via Imperial Weave EventBus. Maps events to existing sound definitions (blade_equip, blunt_equip, bow_shoot) as temporary placeholders. Supports 3D positional audio via player position and optional NPC position callback. Dedicated hit/block/death combat sounds need extraction from original assets.

SpellSelectionPanel implemented. Draggable panel extending UIPanel that displays player spells as clickable buttons. Japanese name preferred with English fallback. Integrated with castSpellButton: first press opens panel, subsequent presses cast selected spell on nearest enemy. Plays magic/spell_equip sound on successful cast. Player ID hardcoded to 1.

Engine layered architecture: Android JNI → Renderer (render loop) → Imperial Weave (12-phase coordinator: ①EventProcess ②World ③AI ④Player ⑤Inventory ⑥Spell ⑦Animation ⑧Physics ⑨Combat ⑩Quest ⑪Audio ⑫RenderSubmit) + UISystem. Thin EventBus-driven subscriber bridges: AnimationSubscriber (Event→AnimationPlayer) and AudioSubscriber (Event→AudioManager). CombatManager emits events, does NOT call AnimationPlayer/AudioManager directly. Diagram committed to README.md Engine Architecture section.

README.md updated for Phase 32 (v0.9.8): added Engine Architecture section with ASCII diagram and EventBus attack flow example, updated code metrics to 13,000+ lines, added Phase 32 to development phases table, updated status footer to Phase 32 Complete, next phase listed as Phase 33 - Dedicated Combat Sound Assets + NPC Spatial Audio.

Phase 33 (v0.9.9) complete. Dedicated combat sounds added to sound_definitions.json (hit_blade/blunt/axe/unarmed, hit_generic, hit_critical, block_generic, parry, dodge, death_generic, attack_swing). NPC spatial audio callback wired: AudioSubscriber.setNpcPositionCallback() connected in Renderer using NpcManager::getNPC(id)->position. All 11 AudioSubscriber event→sound mappings updated from blade_equip placeholder to dedicated keys. BUILD SUCCESSFUL.

Phase 34 (v0.9.10) complete. (1) Weapon-type hit sound routing: CombatManager emits weaponType in EventBus payload, AudioSubscriber.playSoundForEventWithPayload() parses it and selects hit_blade/blunt/axe/bow etc. (2) SpellSelectionPanel school colors: each school has distinct color + abbreviated prefix [破][回][召][変][幻][神]. (3) Quick-slot spells: Player.quickSlotSpells[4] array, Renderer has 4 F1-F4 buttons bottom-left; empty=open panel in assign mode, assigned=cast spell. pendingAssignSlot tracks assignment. BUILD SUCCESSFUL.

Phase 35 (v1.0.0) complete. Radiant AI system implemented: (1) AI Package System with 15 package types (Eat, Sleep, Wander, Travel, Patrol, Follow, Escort, Guard, Activate, Combat, Flee, Accompany, UseItem, SandBox, Dialogue). (2) Priority-based PackageStack with conditions (TimeCondition, LocationCondition, StatCondition). (3) AIScheduler with 24h time-based package selection, NavMesh pathfinding, stuck detection (3s timeout). (4) Default daily schedule: Sleep(22:00-06:00,p60), Eat(12:00-13:00,p55), Wander(all day,p30), SandBox(fallback,p20). (5) Combat(p90)/Flee(p95) override normal behavior. (6) Integrated into Renderer update loop after ImperialWeave.update(). (7) All NPCs auto-registered with createDefaultSchedule(). BUILD SUCCESSFUL.

ESM AI data parsing complete. Added AIDT subrecord parsing for NPC records: (1) AIPackageType enum with 15 types (NONE, FIND, FOLLOW, ESCORT, TRAVEL, WANDER, SLEEP, EAT, COMBAT, FLEE, YIELD, DIALOGUE, ACCOMPANY, USE_ITEM, WAIT). (2) AIPackageData struct with type, flags, schedule (day/hour/duration), targetFormID, targetXYZ, locationFormID, wanderDistance, idleTime. (3) NPCData extended with aggression, confidence, energy, responsibility, mood, aiFlags fields. (4) AI package subrecord parsing: AI_A (Activate/Find), AI_E (Escort), AI_F (Follow), AI_T (Travel), AI_W (Wander), AI_PK (newer format). (5) All NPCs now have authentic AI data from ESM files. BUILD SUCCESSFUL.

Audio system bug fixes complete. (1) AudioSource::setVolume/setPosition/enable3D/disable3D now properly call OpenAL functions when AUDIO_SYSTEM_ENABLED is defined. (2) WAV parsing uses safe little-endian read helpers instead of direct pointer casting (endian-independent). (3) Added boundary checks for WAV chunk parsing to prevent buffer overrun. (4) Added PCM format validation. (5) Added 2-byte alignment padding support for WAV chunks. BUILD SUCCESSFUL.

Kotlin audio system bug fixes complete. (1) SoundPool: Added loadedSounds cache to prevent memory leak from repeated sp.load() calls. (2) SoundPool: Set OnLoadCompleteListener only once to avoid overwriting previous listeners. (3) MediaPlayer: Changed from file:///android_asset/ URI to AssetFileDescriptor for reliable asset loading. (4) Thread safety: Added runOnUiThread wrappers for playBGM/playSE/stopBGM to handle C++ callbacks from non-UI threads. (5) Instance: Added @Volatile annotation and identity check in onDestroy for screen rotation safety. (6) onPause: Simplified redundant null check. BUILD SUCCESSFUL.

Phase 36 Complete: Jolt Physics engine integrated. PhysicsManager singleton with CharacterVirtual for player/NPC, HeightFieldShape terrain, fixed timestep (1/60s), raycast API. JPH_DISABLE_CUSTOM_ALLOCATOR removed (causes linker errors). HeightFieldShapeSettings requires uint32 for sampleCount. Build successful on ARM64.

Fixed 10 critical bugs: (1) castSpell argument order, (2) const reference violation in worldEntities loop, (3) Use-after-move in loadActorForNpc, (4) uninitialized fixedAccumulator, (5) negative coordinate uint32_t cast, (6) GLM mat4 initialization, (7) BGM double playback (OpenAL+Java), (8) infinite recursion in spawnFromLeveledList, (9) player status not reflected in combat, (10) iterator invalidation in quest update loop.

Fixed 19 additional bugs (batch 2): (11) NIF readString 1MB limit, (12) NIF parseNiSkinPartition/KeyframeData/ControllerSequence OOM guards, (13) BSA entry.size<4 underflow guard, (14) collision division-by-zero guard, (15) native_activity render thread exit fix, (16) temp file cleanup in asset_manager, (17) LRU lastAccessTime update, (19) ui_manager self-assignment fix, (20) 64bit pointer cast in mesh.cpp, (21) SkinnedMesh GL_UNSIGNED_SHORT noted, (22) NIF readHeader variable-length magic, (24) title_screen redundant glClear removed, (25) actual frame time in renderingThread, (26) quickSlotBar touch handling, (27) NiControllerSequence OOM guard, (28) broadPhaseCollect iterator safety noted, (29) path separator normalization.

Batch 4 bug fixes completed (15 bugs #61-75): alchemy_system.cpp (memory leak, fixed ID, single effect, data model), equipment_effect_system.cpp (stat accumulation, double armor, weapon overwrite, maxHP heal), book_reader.cpp (skill formID resolution, empty skills, random selection), clothing_converter.cpp (memory leak, ring slot conflict, slot detection). Build succeeded, committed as 1f5aeb6, pushed to master.

Batch 3 bug fixes completed (15 bugs #30-47): camera rotate() vector recalculation, aspectRatio/fov validation, far plane 100->1000, shader GL object validation + uniform caching, texture_loader AAsset_read validation + mipmap + thread safety, skeleton mat4 init + m[i][j] fix + getBone bounds, navmesh isPointInTriangle + findTriangle containment check. Build successful, pushed as 3c5f262.

Batch 5 bug fixes completed (5 bugs): renderer.cpp (null check titleScreen, actual player position in save/load), interaction_manager.cpp (transition-only enter/exit callbacks, size capture before clear), ai_package.cpp/h (evaluate() implementation, conditionsMet field). Build succeeded, committed as 3d88d85, pushed to master. Total bugs fixed: 64 across 5 batches.

Batch 6 bug fixes completed (8 bugs): faction_manager.cpp (int64_t overflow), merchant.cpp/h (quantity-aware removeItem), world_manager.cpp (uint32_t negative coord key), combat_manager.cpp (function-local static RNG), quest_manager.cpp (state transition ACCEPTED→IN_PROGRESS, duplicate prevention, empty objectives true), save_manager.cpp (playerPosition JSON parsing). Build succeeded, committed as 561b6be, pushed to master. Total bugs fixed: 72 across 6 batches.

Handbook.md updated (commit 60779c8): Added Current Project Status section with Phase 1-36 completion table, Code Metrics (22,500+ C++ lines, 40 ESM types, 72 bug fixes), Architecture Overview, Key Technical Decisions (namespace arch, Player=NPC ID 1, GLM gotcha, build system), Bug Fix History table, Phase 37 Script VM status. Version bumped to 2.0.

README.md engine architecture diagram updated: 7-layer architecture (JNI → Renderer → Imperial Weave → Game Systems → World/Physics → Asset/Data → Animation/Audio → System/Persistence → Third-Party). Namespace table added. Badges updated to Phase 36 + Jolt Physics. C++ line count updated to 22,500+. Weapon-type sound routing in EventBus example.

Next steps: (1) Phase 37 Script VM implementation - design complete, ~2,050 lines estimated, needs SCPT parser + bytecode interpreter + game function API. (2) Remaining unfixed bugs: Bug #5 (combat dangling pointer - likely not actual), Bug #16 (FORTIFY_ATTR tracking), Bug #17 (mana clamping - already handled), Bug #18 (gravity - ExtendedUpdate handles). GLM rules for Oblivion Android (CRITICAL): 1) glm::vec3(0.0f) does NOT compile - use glm::vec3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f), 2) glm::mat4(1.0f) does NOT compile - use glm::mat4() (default constructor = identity), 3) Use .x/.y/.z not .r/.g/.b (no rgb accessors in custom glm), 4) Use %lu not %llu for size_t on arm64 Android. Project uses custom glm stub, not full GLM library.

Oblivion coordinate system: X-Z is horizontal plane, Y is height. Cell size = 4096 units. CellCoordUtils::getCoordFromWorldPos() must use worldPos.z for cell Y coordinate, not worldPos.y. Door positions: glm::vec3(x, 0.0f, z) not glm::vec3(x, y, 0.0f). This is a common source of bugs in the codebase.

Project architecture patterns: Imperial Weave v4.0 (15-phase pipeline), EventBus (decoupled messaging), Manager Pattern (initialize/update/cleanup lifecycle), Singleton with ServiceLocator. All engine files are header-only with inline implementations. Build: ./gradlew clean build, Install: adb install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk, Log: adb logcat -s OblivionEngine.

AI-generated bug review workflow: NEVER blindly apply patches from external AI reviews (Kimi, ChatGPT, etc.). Always verify each claim against actual source code. Out of 6 Kimi claims, only 2 were valid bugs. The other 4 were incorrect due to: (1) not understanding custom GLM default ctor initializes to identity, (2) not understanding uint32_t cast preserves bit patterns for signed values, (3) not checking existing null guards, (4) cosmetic-only issues.

Custom GLM mat4 behavior: The default constructor mat4() initializes to IDENTITY matrix (not uninitialized). There is NO mat4(float) constructor. vec3 also has NO single-scalar constructor. vec2/vec4 DO have single-scalar ctors. Do NOT use mat4(1.0f) - it will fail to compile. Use mat4() for identity initialization.

Cell coordinate key encoding in world_manager.cpp is CORRECT: uint64_t key = (uint64_t)(uint32_t)cellX << 32 | (uint32_t)cellY. Signed-to-unsigned cast preserves bit patterns via two's complement. (-1,0) produces 0xFFFFFFFF00000000, (0,-1) produces 0x00000000FFFFFFFF - these are DIFFERENT keys. No collision possible for Oblivion's cell range (-64 to +64).

AndroidアプリのUI開発にはKotlinを使用。C++はUIに不適切。理由: Android UIフレームワーク（Jetpack Compose、XML）はKotlin/Java前提、C++はJNI経由で複雑化。推奨構成: UI=Kotlin、ゲームロジック=C++(NDK)。Oblivion_Androidの既存パターンもこの構成。
